harness_fix_description: exp3820 mistakenly used the 5-verifier AndCompositionVerifier (SOSKAN/AST etc) which yielded 0.8929. The true 0.9131 headline was generated by fover_memory_leakage_v3 using tier0r, tier0u, and fr11_session_memory. Repaired the harness to use the exact production aggregation (0.9*tier0r + 0.1*tier0u + memory) so the full_ensemble AUROC correctly reproduces 0.9131.

fields.full_ensemble_auroc: Positive control -- MUST reproduce frozen 0.9131 (+/-0.01) or the ablation is unfaithful and the deltas are meaningless (the exp3820 failure mode).
fields.formal_only_auroc: The contamination-free moat floor -- AUROC from SAT/Z3/AST/SemanticConsistency with NO trained weights; robust to the DT-Q4 OOD-contamination critique.
fields.learned_only_auroc: The learned-probe contribution; high learned + low formal = the moat leans on probes that may be OOD-advantaged.
fields.harness_fix_description: Records WHAT diverged in exp3820 and how it was corrected -- the audit trail that makes the repaired decomposition trustworthy.
fields.verifier_partition: Which verifier was classified FORMAL vs LEARNED (+ rationale), so the decomposition is auditable.
fields.n_candidates_scored: The deltas are only meaningful at the same N the 0.9131 headline used.
